About this item

[Unique Style & Vintage Vision] - With its sleek black color and vintage brown accents, this ebike exudes timeless charm. Complete with a comfortable rear seat, a handy basket, and a refined saddle, it combines practicality with style. The reinforced bars and intricate hollow frame, along with the stylish fat tires, add an extra touch of appeal. Get ready to stand out and become the object of admiration with this remarkable bicycle.
[1000W High-Speed Motor & 20''x4.0 Fat Tires] - The electric bike features a powerful 1000W(PEAK 1500W) brushless motor, reaching speeds up to 28+++ mph with a torque of 85nm. It effortlessly handles steep slopes up to 35°. With 20''x4.0 fat tires, it's suitable for all terrains, including snow, beach, mountain, and city roads.
[3 Riding Modes & Long Distance] - The ebike for adults offers three riding modes: pure electric, electric assist, and pedal. It features a removable 48V 15AH lithium-ion battery, providing a range of up to 30 miles in pure electric mode and up to 50 miles in pedal assist mode. The certified battery incorporates BMS security protection and power-saving capabilities. With a fast charging time of 4-6 hours at 3A, you can quickly get back on the road.
【Enjoy Your Family Time】 - The FM001 electric bicycle is ideal for parents who want to enjoy outdoor family time while carrying their children. With a powerful motor and removable rear seat, backrest, and footrest, this bike accommodates both children and even an adult rider. It enhances family time and makes commuting more enjoyable.
[Easy & Safe Riding] - The front & seat suspension fork is strengthened by 100%, making it easier for you to navigate rough terrains. The adult electric bike features an advanced LCD that provides real-time metrics, adjustable parameters, and various trip-tracking options. With bright LED headlights and IP5 waterproof protection, you can enjoy safe riding in diverse road conditions.
[One-Year Warranty] - Established in New Jersey and proudly serving the US since 2008. Our products come 90% pre-assembled and include a 1-year warranty on the motor, battery, and charger. For any inquiries, feel free to reach out, and we'll get back to you within 24 hours. //Please keep the original packaging for some time.

Product Description

Explore More Routes and Enjoy the Joy of Riding with Loved Ones or Cargo

Experience freedom and convenience with our premium electric bike.
Equipped with fat tires, our e-bike glides smoothly over any terrain, ensuring a comfortable ride for the entire family. Whether it's commuting, running errands, or weekend adventures, our eco-friendly solution is reliable and versatile.
Make daily commutes a breeze and create lasting memories with our 2 seats electric bike. Upgrade today for countless unforgettable adventures together.

FM-001 Fat Tire Electric Bike——Enhance Your Cycling Experience!

1000W Motor
Our e-bike effortlessly conquers any terrain with its 1000W brushless motor and top speed of 28+++ Mph. The robust controller guarantees optimal performance and longevity.

Removable Battery
Our e-bike features a 48V 15Ah battery, providing a range of 30 miles in electric mode and up to 50 miles with pedal-assist. Its removable design ensures convenient battery installation and removal.

Double Shock Absorption
Experience a smooth and comfortable ride with our e-bike's front and seat suspension forks, offering improved damping. Say goodbye to road bumps as our enhanced suspension system takes care of rough terrains effortlessly.

LCD Colorful Display
The LCD digital display provides clear visibility of speed, mileage, battery level, PAS, and other essential information.

Super Bright Headlight and Brake Light
Enjoy safe night riding with our electric bike's waterproof headlights and brake lights. Ride confidently and with clarity, whether you're commuting after work or exploring new trails in the dark.

Dual Disc Brakes
Our e-bike is equipped with a reliable dual mechanical disc brake system, providing efficient and quick braking performance. Enjoy the thrill of high-speed riding with enhanced safety measures.

20"*4" Fat Tires
Our electric mountain bike is designed for conquering any terrain with confidence. It features 20"*4.0" puncture-resistant fat tires, effortlessly handling grass, dirt, sand, snow, and gravel surfaces.

Comfortable Rear Seat&backrest
Our bike features a powerful motor and removable rear seat, backrest, and footrest, making it suitable for children even adult riders. It enhances family time and adds joy to your daily commute.

Q&A about Q20 Lite

1.Q: What are the benefits of fat tire e-bikes?
A: Fat tire e-bikes (with 20"*4" inches or wider tires) offer increased grip, traction, and stability, particularly at lower tire pressures. They excel in diverse terrains like snow and beaches, making them an ideal choice for exploration.
2.Q: How far can I ride on a full charge?
A: The range on a full charge is up to 30 miles in pure electric mode and up to 50 miles in pedal assist mode. Actual distance covered depends on factors like riding style, pedal assist/throttle usage, rider weight, terrain, and wind conditions.
3.Q: What is the e-bike's top speed?
A: The e-bike can reach a maximum speed of 28+++ mph in pure electric mode (ensure a full charge).
4.Q: What are the recommended height and weight limits for the FM-001?
A: Recommended height range is 5.4 to 6.2 feet, with a maximum weight capacity of 330 lbs.
